地球在每年一月初附近最接近太阳，此时北半球仍处于冬季。: Earth is closest to the Sun around early January, during northern winter.
地球赤道略微鼓起，因此它并不是一个完美的球体。: Earth bulges slightly at the equator, so it is not a perfect sphere.
地球是目前唯一已知存在生命的世界。: Earth is the only world currently known to host life.
火星的红色来自表面含铁矿物的氧化，类似铁锈的颜色。: Mars's red color comes from oxidized iron minerals, much like rust.
火星上的一天约 24 小时 39 分钟，与地球的一天相近。: A Martian day lasts about 24 hours 39 minutes, close to an Earth day.
奥林帕斯山是一座巨大的盾状火山，远比地球最高山峰高。: Olympus Mons is an enormous shield volcano, far taller than Earth's highest mountains.
水手谷是巨大的峡谷系统，延伸数千公里。: Valles Marineris is a vast canyon system extending thousands of kilometers.
火星大气十分稀薄，主要由二氧化碳组成。: Mars has a very thin atmosphere, mostly carbon dioxide.
火星极冠包含水冰，也有随季节变化的二氧化碳冰。: Mars's polar caps contain water ice and seasonally changing carbon dioxide ice.
干涸河谷和三角洲表明，古代火星曾有液态水流动。: Dry valleys and deltas show that liquid water once flowed on ancient Mars.
火星沙尘暴有时会发展到覆盖几乎整个星球。: Martian dust storms sometimes grow to cover nearly the entire planet.
火星有两颗小卫星：火卫一和火卫二。: Mars has two small moons: Phobos and Deimos.
火星也有季节，但由于一年更长，各季节通常比地球的长。: Mars has seasons, generally longer than Earth's because its year is longer.
木星的质量超过太阳系其他行星质量总和的两倍。: Jupiter is more than twice as massive as all the other planets combined.
木星没有像地球那样可供站立的固体表面，向内压力会不断升高。: Jupiter has no solid ground like Earth; pressure keeps rising deeper inside.
木星的大红斑是一场持续了很长时间的巨大风暴。: Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a huge, long-lived storm.
木星不到十小时就自转一圈，是八大行星中自转最快的。: Jupiter rotates in under ten hours, the fastest spin among the eight planets.
木星也有环，只是远没有土星环醒目。: Jupiter has rings, though much less conspicuous than Saturn's.
木星明暗相间的条带来自大气环流和不同性质的云层。: Jupiter's light and dark bands arise from atmospheric circulation and differing clouds.
木星强大的磁场形成了广阔磁层和强烈的辐射环境。: Jupiter's powerful magnetic field creates a vast magnetosphere and intense radiation.
伽利略在 1610 年观测到的四颗大卫星，证明并非所有天体都绕地球转。: The four large moons Galileo observed in 1610 showed that not everything orbits Earth.
朱诺号通过测量引力和磁场，研究木星云层之下的内部结构。: Juno measures gravity and magnetism to study Jupiter's interior beneath its clouds.
1994 年，苏梅克—列维 9 号彗星的碎片撞击木星，留下明显暗斑。: Fragments of Comet Shoemaker–Levy 9 hit Jupiter in 1994, leaving prominent dark scars.
土星环由无数独立绕行的颗粒组成，以水冰为主。: Saturn's rings consist of countless independently orbiting particles, mostly water ice.
土星的平均密度比水小，但并不存在能容纳它的真实浴缸。: Saturn's average density is below water's, though no real bathtub could hold it.
土星环虽然横跨很大范围，垂直方向却相当薄。: Saturn's rings span a huge width but are very thin vertically.
卡西尼缝是土星环中的显著间隙，里面并非完全没有物质。: The Cassini Division is a prominent gap in Saturn's rings, but it is not completely empty.
土星北极有著名的六边形大气流动结构。: Saturn's north pole has a famous hexagonal atmospheric flow pattern.
土星快速自转，使赤道明显鼓起。: Saturn's rapid rotation produces a pronounced equatorial bulge.
卡西尼号于 2004 年进入土星轨道，持续研究到 2017 年。: Cassini entered Saturn orbit in 2004 and studied the system until 2017.
惠更斯号在 2005 年穿过浓厚大气，降落到土卫六表面。: Huygens descended through Titan's thick atmosphere and landed in 2005.
土卫二喷出的冰粒不断补充土星稀薄的 E 环。: Ice grains from Enceladus continually replenish Saturn's faint E ring.
土星也有季节，从地球看到的环倾角会随着公转而改变。: Saturn has seasons; the apparent tilt of its rings from Earth changes along its orbit.
天王星自转轴倾斜约 98°，看起来像侧躺着绕太阳滚动。: Uranus's axis tilts about 98°, making it appear to roll around the Sun on its side.
天王星大气中的甲烷吸收红光，使它呈现蓝绿色。: Methane in Uranus's atmosphere absorbs red light, giving it a blue-green appearance.
天王星属于冰巨星，内部含有较多水、氨和甲烷等物质。: Uranus is an ice giant, with relatively large amounts of water, ammonia, and methane inside.
威廉·赫歇尔于 1781 年发现天王星，最初曾将它当作彗星。: William Herschel discovered Uranus in 1781 and initially thought it was a comet.
天王星有暗淡的行星环，其中一些通过恒星掩星观测被发现。: Uranus has faint rings, some first detected when they occulted a star.
天王星极区会经历长达数十年的连续日照或黑暗。: Uranus's poles can experience decades of continuous sunlight or darkness.
旅行者 2 号于 1986 年飞越天王星，拍摄了行星和卫星。: Voyager 2 flew past Uranus in 1986, imaging the planet and its moons.
天王星磁轴相对自转轴大幅倾斜，而且磁场中心偏离行星中心。: Uranus's magnetic axis is highly tilted to its spin axis, and the field is offset from the planet's center.
天王星主要卫星的名字来自莎士比亚和亚历山大·蒲柏的作品。: Uranus's major moons are named after characters in works by Shakespeare and Alexander Pope.
冰巨星中的“冰”指物质类别，不表示整颗行星是坚硬冰球。: Ice in ice giant refers to classes of material, not an entire planet made of solid ice.
海王星于 1846 年被发现，数学预测帮助天文学家找到它。: Neptune was discovered in 1846 with the help of mathematical predictions.
海王星有极强的高空风，速度能超过地球上的音速。: Neptune's high-altitude winds can exceed the speed of sound on Earth.
旅行者 2 号于 1989 年飞越海王星，是一次重要的近距离探测。: Voyager 2's 1989 Neptune flyby was a landmark close-up exploration.
海王星大气中的甲烷会吸收红光，影响它的可见颜色。: Methane in Neptune's atmosphere absorbs red light, affecting its visible color.
海王星著名的大暗斑是大气风暴，风暴会形成、变化和消失。: Neptune's Great Dark Spot was an atmospheric storm; such storms form, change, and disappear.
海王星有暗淡的环，部分环内物质分布不均匀，形成环弧。: Neptune has faint rings, with unevenly distributed material forming arcs in some of them.
海卫一沿着与海王星自转相反的方向公转。: Triton orbits opposite to Neptune's rotation.
海王星向外释放的能量多于它从太阳吸收的能量。: Neptune emits more energy than it absorbs from the Sun.
海王星在 2011 年完成了自发现以来的第一次绕日公转。: Neptune completed its first orbit since discovery in 2011.
海王星没有能像地球地面一样供人站立的固体外表面。: Neptune has no solid outer surface to stand on like Earth's ground.
冥王星属于矮行星，是柯伊伯带中的重要成员。: Pluto is a dwarf planet and a major member of the Kuiper Belt.
新视野号于 2015 年飞越冥王星，首次带来清晰的近距离影像。: New Horizons flew past Pluto in 2015, returning its first clear close-up images.
冥王星表面的心形明亮区域被称为汤博区。: Pluto's bright heart-shaped region is called Tombaugh Regio.
斯普特尼克平原覆盖着氮冰，表面显示出地质活动的痕迹。: Sputnik Planitia is covered in nitrogen ice and shows signs of geological activity.
在冥王星的低温环境下，水冰可以像岩石一样构成山体。: In Pluto's cold environment, water ice can build mountains like rock.
冥王星稀薄大气以氮为主，还含有甲烷和一氧化碳。: Pluto's thin atmosphere is mainly nitrogen, with methane and carbon monoxide.
冥王星与冥卫一共同绕行的质心位于冥王星之外。: Pluto and Charon orbit a shared center of mass outside Pluto itself.
冥王星与海王星存在 3∶2 轨道共振，有助于避免近距离相遇。: Pluto's 3:2 orbital resonance with Neptune helps prevent close encounters.
冥王星在部分轨道区段比海王星更靠近太阳。: For part of its orbit, Pluto is closer to the Sun than Neptune.
椭圆轨道上的太阳位于一个焦点，而不是椭圆的几何中心。: The Sun lies at a focus of an elliptical orbit, not at its geometric center.
同一条椭圆轨道上，天体靠近太阳时通常运行得更快。: Along a given elliptical orbit, a body generally moves faster near the Sun.
轨道偏心率为零时是圆；偏心率越接近一，椭圆越细长。: An eccentricity of zero is a circle; as it approaches one, the ellipse becomes more elongated.
恒星日以远方恒星为参照；太阳日以太阳再次经过同一子午线为参照。: A sidereal day uses distant stars as a reference; a solar day measures the Sun's return to the same meridian.
天体的自转轴倾斜会改变各纬度收到阳光的方式，是季节形成的重要因素。: Axial tilt changes how sunlight reaches different latitudes and is a key cause of seasons.
我们用肉眼看到的行星亮光，主要来自它们反射的太阳光。: The visible light of planets seen with the naked eye is mainly reflected sunlight.
轨道倾角需要说明参考平面；太阳系行星常用地球轨道平面作为参考。: Orbital inclination needs a reference plane; planetary orbits often use Earth's orbital plane.
一颗天体的质量和半径共同影响表面引力，体积更大不一定引力更强。: Mass and radius together determine surface gravity; a larger body need not have stronger gravity.
太阳系不是静止的平面图，行星还会在轨道参考平面的上下运动。: The Solar System is not a static flat diagram: planets move above and below the reference plane.
望远镜看到的是光离开天体时的状态；越遥远，光传播所需时间通常越长。: A telescope shows a body as it was when its light left; greater distance generally means a longer light-travel time.
太阳是一颗恒星，靠核心中的核聚变释放能量。: The Sun is a star powered by nuclear fusion in its core.
太阳核心把氢聚变成氦，少量质量转化为能量。: The solar core fuses hydrogen into helium, converting a little mass into energy.
太阳约占整个太阳系总质量的 99.8%。: The Sun contains about 99.8% of the Solar System's total mass.
太阳可见表面的温度约为 5,500 摄氏度。: The Sun's visible surface is about 5,500°C.
太阳核心温度约为 1,500 万摄氏度。: The Sun's core is about 15 million°C.
太阳可见的表层叫光球，并不是坚硬的地面。: The visible solar layer is the photosphere, not solid ground.
太阳外层大气叫日冕，温度可达百万摄氏度。: The Sun's outer atmosphere, the corona, can reach millions of degrees Celsius.
日全食期间，明亮光球被遮住，可以看见日冕。: During a total solar eclipse, the bright photosphere is hidden and the corona becomes visible.
太阳黑子是较冷、磁场较强的区域，仍然十分炽热。: Sunspots are cooler, strongly magnetic regions, but remain extremely hot.
太阳活动有大约 11 年的周期，并不是每次都严格等长。: Solar activity follows a roughly 11-year cycle whose length varies.
太阳不是刚体，赤道区域通常比极区自转更快。: The Sun is not rigid; equatorial regions usually rotate faster than polar regions.
太阳风是从太阳向外流动的带电粒子。: The solar wind consists of charged particles flowing outward from the Sun.
太阳耀斑会迅速释放能量，可能影响地球无线电通信。: Solar flares rapidly release energy and can affect radio communication on Earth.
日冕物质抛射会把大量等离子体和磁场送入太空。: Coronal mass ejections send large amounts of plasma and magnetic field into space.
极光来自带电粒子与高层大气相互作用，太阳活动会影响它。: Auroras arise when charged particles interact with the upper atmosphere; solar activity influences them.
光从太阳到地球平均需要约 8 分 20 秒。: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes 20 seconds to reach Earth on average.
太阳的年龄约为 46 亿年。: The Sun is about 4.6 billion years old.
太阳最终会膨胀成红巨星，但这属于数十亿年后的演化。: The Sun will eventually expand into a red giant, billions of years from now.
太阳质量不足以在生命末期发生核心坍缩型超新星爆炸。: The Sun is not massive enough to end its life as a core-collapse supernova.
太阳最终留下的致密核心将成为白矮星。: The Sun's remaining dense core will eventually become a white dwarf.
太阳主要由氢和氦组成。: The Sun is made mainly of hydrogen and helium.
太阳光经过棱镜能展开成光谱，谱线能揭示化学成分。: A prism spreads sunlight into a spectrum; spectral lines reveal its chemical composition.
光球上的米粒状结构与表面附近的对流有关。: Granules on the photosphere are linked to convection near the surface.
太阳也在运动，和太阳系一起绕银河系中心运行。: The Sun moves too, orbiting the Milky Way's center with the Solar System.
太阳绕银河系一周需要约两亿多年。: The Sun takes a little over 200 million years to orbit the Milky Way once.
太阳影响范围远超海王星，太阳风吹出的巨大区域称为日球层。: The Sun's influence extends far beyond Neptune; its solar wind creates the vast heliosphere.
太阳系天体共同绕质心运动，太阳也会因行星引力而轻微摆动。: Solar System bodies orbit their common center of mass; planets make the Sun wobble slightly too.
太阳在太空中看起来接近白色，地球大气会改变我们看到的颜色。: The Sun looks nearly white in space; Earth's atmosphere changes the colors we see.
太阳的引力把八大行星及许多小天体维系在绕日轨道上。: Solar gravity keeps the eight planets and many small bodies in orbits around the Sun.
太阳内部有辐射区与对流区，能量通过不同方式向外传递。: Inside the Sun, radiative and convective zones transport energy outward in different ways.
哈雷彗星是第一颗被确认会周期性回归的彗星。: Halley's Comet was the first comet recognized as returning periodically.
埃德蒙·哈雷比较了多次历史观测，推断它们属于同一颗彗星。: Edmond Halley compared historical sightings and inferred they were the same comet.
哈雷彗星最近一次经过近日点是在 1986 年。: Halley's Comet last passed perihelion in 1986.
哈雷彗星预计在 2061 年再次回到近日点附近。: Halley's Comet is expected to return near perihelion in 2061.
哈雷彗星逆向绕太阳公转，与大多数行星相反。: Halley's Comet orbits retrograde, opposite to most planets.
乔托号在 1986 年近距离拍摄了哈雷彗核。: Giotto photographed Halley's nucleus up close in 1986.
哈雷彗核形状不规则，表面很暗，并不是一颗明亮冰球。: Halley's nucleus is irregular and very dark, not a bright ball of ice.
宝瓶座 η 流星雨与哈雷彗星留下的碎屑有关。: The Eta Aquariid meteor shower comes from debris left by Halley's Comet.
猎户座流星雨也来自哈雷彗星的碎屑流。: The Orionid meteor shower also comes from Halley's debris stream.
哈雷彗星一圈大约需要 76 年，具体周期会受行星引力影响。: Halley's orbital period is roughly 76 years, varying with planetary gravity.
恩克彗星绕太阳一周只需约 3.3 年。: Encke's Comet orbits the Sun in only about 3.3 years.
恩克彗星以计算其周期轨道的约翰·恩克命名。: Encke's Comet is named for Johann Encke, who calculated its periodic orbit.
恩克彗星最早在 1786 年被皮埃尔·梅尚观测到。: Pierre Méchain first observed Encke's Comet in 1786.
恩克把不同年份的彗星观测联系起来，确认它们是同一个天体。: Encke linked observations from different years to confirm they described the same body.
恩克彗星的正式编号为 2P，是很早获得周期彗星编号的成员。: Encke's official designation is 2P, among the earliest numbered periodic comets.
恩克彗核直径约为 4.8 公里，比大行星小得多。: Encke's nucleus is about 4.8 km across, far smaller than a major planet.
恩克彗星与金牛座流星群的碎屑复合体有关。: Encke's Comet is associated with the Taurid meteoroid complex.
恩克彗星近日点在水星轨道以内，轨道远端延伸到火星之外。: Encke's perihelion lies inside Mercury's orbit; its far end reaches beyond Mars.
恩克彗星的轨道偏心率很高，离太阳的距离变化显著。: Encke's highly eccentric orbit causes large changes in its distance from the Sun.
频繁回归意味着恩克彗星反复经历太阳加热与物质流失。: Frequent returns expose Encke repeatedly to solar heating and material loss.
67P 彗星于 1969 年被发现，名称来自两位发现者。: Comet 67P was discovered in 1969 and named after its two discoverers.
67P 彗星的双叶形彗核常被比喻成小鸭子。: 67P's two-lobed nucleus is often compared to a rubber duck.
罗塞塔号于 2014 年抵达 67P，成为首艘绕彗星运行的探测器。: Rosetta reached 67P in 2014 and became the first spacecraft to orbit a comet.
菲莱着陆器在 2014 年首次实现了彗星表面着陆。: Philae made the first landing on a comet's surface in 2014.
菲莱首次接触表面后发生弹跳，最终停在阴影较多的位置。: Philae bounced after first touching the surface and finally settled in a shaded location.
罗塞塔号跟随 67P 经过 2015 年的近日点，观察活动变化。: Rosetta followed 67P through its 2015 perihelion to observe changes in activity.
67P 表面有陡崖、坑洞和覆盖尘埃的区域，地形十分复杂。: 67P has cliffs, pits, and dusty regions, giving it complex terrain.
67P 曾近距离经过木星，木星引力显著改变了它的轨道。: A close encounter with Jupiter significantly changed 67P's orbit.
罗塞塔号在 2016 年以受控下降到彗星表面的方式结束任务。: Rosetta ended its mission in 2016 with a controlled descent to the comet's surface.
彗星喷气会施加微小推力，67P 的自转也会随活动发生变化。: Outgassing exerts small thrusts, so 67P's spin also changes with its activity.
海尔—波普彗星于 1995 年由艾伦·海尔和托马斯·波普独立发现。: Alan Hale and Thomas Bopp independently discovered Hale–Bopp in 1995.
海尔—波普彗星的正式名称是 C/1995 O1。: Hale–Bopp's official designation is C/1995 O1.
海尔—波普彗星在 1997 年经过近日点，成为著名的明亮彗星。: Hale–Bopp passed perihelion in 1997, becoming a celebrated bright comet.
海尔—波普彗星在离太阳仍很远时就展现出明显活动。: Hale–Bopp was already notably active while still far from the Sun.
海尔—波普是一颗长周期彗星，回归需要数千年。: Hale–Bopp is a long-period comet whose return takes thousands of years.
海尔—波普的彗核估计有数十公里宽，明显大于许多熟悉的彗核。: Hale–Bopp's nucleus is estimated to span tens of kilometers, much larger than many familiar comets.
海尔—波普曾同时展现明亮的尘埃尾和较直的离子尾。: Hale–Bopp displayed both a bright dust tail and a straighter ion tail.
海尔—波普的轨道高度倾斜，远离行星主要所在的轨道平面。: Hale–Bopp's highly inclined orbit carries it far from the main planetary orbital plane.
海尔—波普的远日点远远超出海王星轨道。: Hale–Bopp's aphelion lies far beyond Neptune's orbit.
海尔—波普的下一次回归不能只靠把一个固定周期加到 1997 年来精确预报。: Adding a fixed period to 1997 is not enough to predict Hale–Bopp's next return precisely.
彗核是彗星的固体主体，主要由冰、尘埃和岩石物质混合组成。: The nucleus is a comet's solid body, made mainly of ice, dust, and rock mixed together.
彗星靠近太阳时，冰可直接升华成气体，并带出尘埃。: Near the Sun, cometary ice can sublimate directly to gas and carry dust with it.
彗核周围弥散的气体与尘埃包层叫彗发。: The diffuse envelope of gas and dust around the nucleus is the coma.
离子尾受太阳风影响，大致朝向背离太阳的方向。: The solar wind influences the ion tail, directing it roughly away from the Sun.
尘埃尾中的颗粒有各自轨道，因此常常形成弯曲的尾巴。: Dust-tail particles have their own orbits, often producing a curved tail.
彗星远离太阳时也可能让尾巴指向前方；彗尾不是沿运动方向拖出的尾气。: A comet's tail can point ahead as it moves away from the Sun; it is not exhaust trailing its motion.
一颗彗星的彗发可以比彗核大很多倍，照片里的亮团并不等于实体大小。: A coma can be many times larger than its nucleus; a photo's bright cloud is not the solid body's size.
地球穿过彗星留下的碎屑流时，可能出现流星雨。: Meteor showers can occur when Earth crosses debris left by a comet.

The large Stickney crater and surface grooves distinguish this small world. Tidal effects slowly alter its orbit and may eventually cause it to break apart or strike Mars.
火卫二比火卫一更小，也在更远的轨道上运行。它同样不是规则球体，但松散的表面物质覆: Deimos is smaller than Phobos and follows a more distant orbit. It too is irregular, but loose surface material covers some of its terrain and gives it a smoother appearance. Comparing the two moons reveals how surface debris, impacts and orbital setting shape small bodies.
被引力持续加热的火山世界: A volcanic world heated by gravity
木卫一的黄色与红色地表，与硫及其化合物有关。持续的火山活动不断覆盖和改变地表，让: Io's yellows and reds are linked to sulfur and its compounds. Persistent volcanism renews the surface, making ancient impact craters difficult to preserve. Jupiter's pull and orbital resonances with neighboring moons repeatedly deform Io, converting orbital energy into heat.
交错冰纹之下，可能是一片海洋: An ocean may lie beneath the fractured ice
木卫二表面的线状纹理和较少的大型撞击坑，说明冰壳经历过改造。磁场观测等证据支持冰: Europa's linear markings and relative scarcity of large craters suggest an ice shell that has been reshaped. Magnetic observations support the interpretation of a liquid ocean below. The key question is whether water, chemistry and energy combine to make a habitable environment; that is distinct from discovering life.
木卫三的直径超过水星，质量却比水星小，说明大小不能单独决定天体的组成和引力。它同: Ganymede is wider than Mercury but less massive, showing why size alone does not determine composition or gravity. Ancient dark terrain contrasts with brighter grooved regions, and the moon generates its own magnetic field. Surface images and magnetic evidence together help reveal its icy, rocky interior.
密集撞击坑，保存漫长历史: A cratered record of deep time
木卫四位于四颗伽利略卫星的最外侧。密集的撞击坑和瓦尔哈拉多环构造，保留着古老表面: Callisto is the outermost Galilean moon. Its many craters and the Valhalla multiring structure preserve an ancient impact record. Compared with active Io, it shows how weak surface renewal allows craters to survive. An old outer shell, however, does not by itself prove that the interior is entirely frozen.
有河流和湖泊，流动的却不是水: Rivers and lakes, but not of water
土卫六的浓厚氮气大气中弥漫着雾霾，可见光难以看清地表。雷达和惠更斯号着陆观测揭示: Titan's dense nitrogen atmosphere is hazy, hiding its surface from visible light. Radar and the Huygens landing revealed a world shaped by liquid methane and ethane. Familiar-looking channels and lake basins operate under chemical and climatic conditions far colder than Earth's.
冰壳裂缝，把内部海洋带到太空: Fractures give a hidden ocean a way out
土卫二虽然很小，南极却有活跃的水汽与冰粒喷流。卡西尼号穿过喷流采样，使研究者能够: Small Enceladus ejects water vapor and ice from its south polar region. Cassini sampled the plumes, allowing indirect study of the ocean beneath the ice without drilling through the shell. Ejected grains also feed Saturn's E ring, connecting the moon's internal activity to the wider planetary system.
小小卫星，巨大的撞击印记: A small moon with a giant impact scar
土卫一的赫歇尔撞击坑相对整颗卫星异常巨大，使它的外观极易辨认。撞击地貌记录了表面: Mimas's Herschel crater is enormous relative to the moon, creating a distinctive silhouette. Impact terrain records surface history, while motion and gravity measurements are needed to investigate the interior. Resonances with ring particles also show how a small moon can influence a region much larger than itself.
土卫八两侧的亮度反差，并不只是照明造成的昼夜差别。尘埃沉积与冰的升华共同改变了表: Iapetus's contrasting hemispheres are not simply day and night. Dust deposits and ice sublimation have altered the surface reflectivity, while an equatorial ridge adds a distinctive landform. Its appearance highlights the need to distinguish surface composition, terrain and lighting when interpreting brightness.
小卫星上的地质拼图: A geological patchwork on a small moon
天卫五的断崖、沟槽和冕状构造彼此交错，使它不像一个均匀老化的冰球。旅行者 2 号: Miranda's cliffs, grooves and coronae form a patchwork rather than a uniformly aged icy surface. Voyager 2 supplied close views, but limited coverage leaves much terrain poorly observed. The visible geology points to a complex history of reshaping, with uncertainty remaining about the processes involved.
峡谷交错，冰面曾被重塑: Canyons trace a reshaped icy surface
天卫一是天王星主要卫星中较明亮的一颗，表面有广泛峡谷和较少大型撞击坑的区域。不同: Ariel is one of Uranus's brighter major moons, with extensive canyons and regions relatively poor in large craters. Its history includes crustal deformation or renewal as well as impacts. Comparing canyons with surrounding older terrain helps establish the relative sequence of those changes.
暗色冰面上的一圈亮光: A bright ring on a dark, cratered world
天卫二在天王星五颗主要卫星中表面最暗，却在温达撞击坑附近有醒目的亮环。大量撞击坑: Umbriel has the darkest surface among Uranus's five major moons, yet a bright ring stands out at Wunda crater. Numerous craters preserve an old surface record, while local bright terrain points to differences in materials or relief. A faint distant appearance does not capture the moon's geological variety.
巨大的峡谷，记录冰壳的伸展: Great canyons record an expanding shell
天卫三是天王星最大的卫星，冰与岩石共同构成这个世界。巨大的断层和峡谷表明，外壳曾: Titania, Uranus's largest moon, is a world of ice and rock. Great faults and canyons show that its outer shell has stretched. Expansion as internal water froze is one possible explanation. Surface photographs offer clues, but cannot by themselves determine the complete history of the deep interior.
远处的撞击坑，留住古老岁月: Ancient terrain beyond the other major moons
天卫四是天王星第二大卫星，也是五颗主要卫星中最外侧的一颗。密集撞击坑和坑底暗色物: Oberon is Uranus's second-largest moon and the outermost of its five major satellites. Dense cratering and dark material on some crater floors make it a record of an old icy surface. Comparison with canyon-rich Ariel reveals different degrees of surface renewal within the same planetary system.
逆向运行的冰冷访客: An icy moon traveling against the flow
海卫一沿海王星自转的相反方向公转，这一特征支持它可能是后来被捕获的天体。它的低温: Triton orbits opposite to Neptune's rotation, supporting the idea that it was captured. Nitrogen ice covers its cold surface, a thin atmosphere surrounds it, and Voyager 2 observed plumes. Its orbit and active terrain challenge the idea of outer-system moons as uniformly quiet, regular ice balls.
一条细长轨道，巨大的距离变化: An elongated orbit with a changing view
海卫二的轨道偏心率很高，因此一圈之中与海王星的距离变化显著。这与靠近行星、轨道接: Nereid's highly eccentric orbit produces large changes in its distance from Neptune. This differs strongly from close, nearly circular regular-moon orbits. Far less surface detail is known than for Triton, so orbital information provides a firmer introduction to this distant small world than a purported global map.
冥卫一的直径约为冥王星的一半，使它们的关系更像一对质量不那么悬殊的伙伴。两者相互: Charon is about half Pluto's diameter, forming an unusually balanced partnership. Mutual tidal locking keeps the same faces opposed as they orbit a center of mass outside Pluto. New Horizons revealed canyons and a reddish polar region: Charon has its own geological history, not a miniature copy of Pluto's.
哈雷把不同时代的彗星观测联系起来，让一个看似偶然的天象成为可以预测的周期性访客。: Halley's comparison of historical sightings turned an apparently unpredictable apparition into a returning visitor. The comet travels backward around the Sun, with a dark nucleus of ice and dust that becomes active as it warms. Debris left along its path produces the Eta Aquariid and Orionid meteor showers.
恩克彗星约每 3.3 年绕太阳一周，频繁穿过内太阳系。细长轨道让它从较冷的远端返: Encke circles the Sun in about 3.3 years, frequently crossing the inner Solar System. Its elongated orbit brings it from a cooler outer reach to intense perihelion sunlight, repeatedly driving activity and material loss. Debris associated with the Taurid complex links this comet to a wider interplanetary dust environment.
67P 的双叶形彗核拥有陡崖、坑洞与尘埃覆盖区，并不是光滑的冰块。罗塞塔号跟随它: 67P's two-lobed nucleus has cliffs, pits and dusty terrain rather than a smooth icy surface. Rosetta followed it through perihelion to observe how gas and dust activity changed with solar heating. Philae's landing also demonstrated the difficulty of operating on an irregular body with very weak gravity.
明亮双尾背后，数千年的旅程: A brilliant apparition on a millennial journey
海尔—波普彗星在 1997 年成为醒目的观测目标，同时展现出尘埃尾和离子尾。它在: Hale-Bopp became a prominent sight in 1997, displaying both dust and ion tails. It was active far from the Sun and has an unusually large nucleus. For a long-period comet like this, gravitational perturbations affect return timing; adding a fixed period to the last appearance is not a precise forecast.

小行星带中最大的天体，也是内太阳系唯一的矮行星。岩石与冰共同塑造了这个世界。: The largest body in the asteroid belt and the only dwarf planet in the inner solar system, Ceres is a world shaped by rock and ice.

奥卡托撞击坑内的明亮区域富含盐类，记录了地下含盐液体与地表之间的联系。: Bright areas in Occator crater contain salts, recording connections between subsurface brines and the surface.

智神星的轨道明显偏离多数主带天体所在的平面。把镜头拉远，可以看到它在黄道上下穿行: Pallas travels well outside the plane occupied by most main-belt objects. Zooming out reveals its path above and below the ecliptic.
欧洲南方天文台的高分辨率观测显示，智神星两个半球都布满大型撞击坑。: High-resolution ESO observations revealed large craters across both hemispheres of Pallas.
智神星的轨道倾角约 35°，比多数主带小行星更大。: Pallas has an orbital inclination of about 35°, greater than that of most main-belt asteroids.
编号为 3 的岩质主带小行星，沿较为偏心的椭圆轨道绕太阳运行。: Numbered 3, Juno is a rocky main-belt asteroid following a noticeably eccentric ellipse around the Sun.
婚神星展示了主带轨道的多样性。它在近日点与远日点之间有明显的日距变化，可与更接近: Juno illustrates the diversity of main-belt orbits. Its large change in solar distance between perihelion and aphelion contrasts with Vesta’s more nearly circular path.

一颗保留早期分层与火山活动痕迹的大型主带天体，是黎明号曾经绕行的目标。: A large main-belt body preserving evidence of early differentiation and volcanism, Vesta was an orbital target of Dawn.
灶神星像一颗未能长成行星的胚胎。它的地表与撞击盆地，帮助科学家追溯太阳系早期岩质: Vesta resembles an embryo that never grew into a planet. Its surface and impact basins help trace the early evolution of rocky bodies.

灵神星的金属与岩石混合物使它成为特殊的探索目标。研究它，可以检验原行星内部物质如: Psyche’s mixture of metal and rock makes it a distinctive exploration target. Studying it can test ideas about how protoplanetary interiors formed and became exposed.

丝川的外形像不规则的双瓣岩块。探测器观测与返回样本一起，揭示了碎石堆天体和普通球: Itokawa has an irregular, two-lobed outline. Spacecraft observations and returned samples revealed links between rubble piles and ordinary chondrite meteorites.
丝川的表面同时存在大块岩石与相对平滑的区域，反映了碎屑在微弱引力下的迁移。: Itokawa has both boulder fields and relatively smooth regions, reflecting debris movement under weak gravity.

贝努是由许多岩块在引力作用下聚集而成的碎石堆。它暗淡而崎岖的表面，保存着早期太阳: Bennu is a rubble pile of rocks held together by gravity. Its dark, rugged surface preserves clues to material from the early solar system.
贝努的赤道附近向外隆起，整体外观类似陀螺，表面遍布大小岩块。: Bennu has an equatorial bulge that gives it a spinning-top outline, with boulders scattered across its surface.
OSIRIS-REx 于 2020 年采集贝努物质，并在 2023 年将样本送回: OSIRIS-REx collected material from Bennu in 2020 and delivered the sample to Earth in 2023.

龙宫与贝努都是研究原始物质的重要样本。对龙宫返回物质的分析，让科学家能在实验室里: Ryugu and Bennu are important records of primitive material. Ryugu’s returned samples let scientists investigate the history of water and organics in a laboratory.
龙宫样本含有经历水作用的矿物与有机物，为研究早期太阳系的化学过程提供了材料。: Ryugu samples contain water-altered minerals and organic matter, providing material for studying early solar-system chemistry.

流星雨来自彗星或小行星沿轨道遗留的尘埃带。地球每年在相近的日期穿过同一条尘埃带，: A meteor shower is dust a comet or asteroid left strewn along its orbit. Earth crosses the same stream on nearly the same dates every year, and the grains enter the atmosphere at tens of kilometres per second, glowing as they vaporise some 80 to 120 km up. Because their paths are parallel, perspective makes every meteor appear to radiate from one point on the sky — which is why showers are named after the constellation holding that radiant.

Conjunction, opposition, greatest elongation, transit and occultation each name one special moment in that geometry.

Over one synodic month we simply see different fractions of the Moon’s sunlit half — and because its orbit is not a circle, the changing distance also changes how large and bright a full Moon appears.
当太阳、地球和月球接近一条直线时，一个天体的影子会落到另一个天体上。月球轨道相对: When the Sun, Earth and Moon line up closely enough, one body’s shadow falls on another. The Moon’s orbit is tilted about 5° to the ecliptic, so eclipses happen only near the nodes — which is exactly why the observatory’s sky-event planner can list future solar and lunar eclipses one after another.
地球自身的运动也在制造周而复始的天象：地轴的倾斜决定昼夜长短与正午太阳高度的年度: Earth’s own motion produces recurring events too: the tilt of its axis sets how day length and noon Sun altitude change through the year, while its elliptical orbit makes the distance to the Sun rise and fall. The two are often confused, yet one governs the seasons and the other only the apparent size of the solar disc.

象限仪座流星雨在每年 1 月初达到极大，出现率与英仙座、双子座同级，却常常被错过: The Quadrantids peak in early January at rates matching the Perseids and Geminids, yet they are routinely missed: the maximum lasts only a few hours, and a few time zones off the mark leaves nothing but stragglers. 多数流星雨的尘埃带足够宽，地球要穿行一两天；象限仪座的这条很窄，峰值前后 6 小: Most streams are wide enough that Earth takes a day or two to cross them. This one is narrow: rates fall by half within six hours either side of the peak. In the same year, one longitude sees a sky full of meteors while the other side of the world sees almost nothing, so it is worth checking a forecast of that year’s maximum before setting out.
目前普遍认为母天体是小行星 2003 EH₁，它的轨道与 1490 年的一次彗星: The parent is generally taken to be asteroid 2003 EH₁, whose orbit matches a comet recorded in 1490 and which is most likely a dormant nucleus that has exhausted its volatiles. Objects like it are a reminder that no sharp line separates comets from asteroids.
极大只持续数小时，出发前先确认当年的预报时刻。: The peak lasts only hours; check the predicted time for the current year before you go.
辐射点在后半夜升高，黎明前几小时最有利。: The radiant climbs after midnight, so the hours before dawn are best.
1 月的夜间寒冷，保暖装备比望远镜更要紧。: January nights are cold; warm clothing matters more than a telescope.
有两千多年观测记录的春季流星雨，偶尔出现短暂爆发。: A spring shower recorded for more than two thousand years, with occasional brief outbursts.
有文字记录最久的一场流星雨: The shower with the longest written record
天琴座流星雨在 4 月下旬极大，寻常年份每小时十余颗，但它是人类记录最早的流星雨: The Lyrids peak in late April at a dozen or so meteors an hour in an ordinary year, but they are among the earliest showers humans wrote down: a Chinese record from 687 BCE describing stars falling like rain is generally read as this shower. Their parent is a long-period comet with a period of about 415 years.
天琴座流星雨的出现率并不稳定，1803 年、1922 年和 1982 年都出现过: Lyrid rates are not steady. In 1803, 1922 and 1982 they briefly approached a hundred an hour, probably because Earth happened to cross a denser filament within the stream. Such outbursts are hard to predict in advance, which adds a little suspense to watching in an ordinary year.
四百年才回来一次的母彗星: A parent comet that returns once in four centuries
C/1861 G1（撒切尔）彗星上一次通过近日点是在 1861 年，下一次要等到: Comet C/1861 G1 (Thatcher) last passed perihelion in 1861 and will not return until the 23rd century. What we see each April is dust it shed on earlier passages, still slowly spreading along the orbit.
辐射点在午夜后升到高空，后半夜条件最好。: The radiant rises high after midnight, so the later hours are best.
亮度中等偏亮，城市近郊也能看到较亮的成员。: Lyrids are moderately bright; the brighter members show even from the edge of a city.
遇上满月的年份，出现率会被月光大幅削弱。: In years when the peak meets a full Moon, moonlight cuts the visible rate sharply.
哈雷彗星留下的高速流星，南半球的观测条件明显更好。: Fast meteors from Halley’s dust, far better placed for the southern hemisphere.
哈雷彗星每年寄来的两封信之一: One of two letters Halley sends every year
宝瓶座η流星雨的尘埃来自 1P/哈雷彗星。地球在 5 月初穿过它轨道的入境一侧，: The Eta Aquariid dust comes from comet 1P/Halley. In early May Earth crosses the inbound side of its orbit, and the meteors arrive at about 66 km/s — fast enough that many leave trains lasting several seconds. The radiant sits just south of the celestial equator, so the further south you are, the longer you can watch it.
为什么南半球更占优势: Why the southern hemisphere has the advantage

At northern mid-latitudes the sky brightens almost as soon as it clears the horizon, leaving a window of roughly an hour; further south there are several dark hours to use. The same shower can yield several times the counted rate at one latitude compared with another.
地球在 10 月还会穿过哈雷轨道的另一侧，形成猎户座流星雨。两场流星雨的速度同样: In October Earth crosses the other side of Halley’s orbit, producing the Orionids. Both showers run near the upper limit of meteor speed for the same reason: their dust travels the same retrograde orbit.
黎明前两小时是唯一有效的窗口，越靠南越充裕。: The two hours before dawn are the only real window, and it widens towards the south.
流星速度快、余迹明显，适合长曝光拍摄。: The meteors are fast and leave visible trains, which suits long exposures.
面向东南方开阔的地平线，不要只盯着辐射点。: Face an open south-eastern horizon rather than staring at the radiant itself.
北半球条件最好的年度流星雨，出现率稳定，极大期夜里温暖。: The best-placed annual shower for the north: steady rates, and warm nights at maximum.
北半球最容易看到的一场: The easiest shower to catch in the north
英仙座流星雨在 8 月 12 日前后极大，理想条件下每小时可见近百颗。它之所以成: The Perseids peak around 12 August, reaching close to a hundred meteors an hour under ideal skies. They are the north’s favourite shower half because the rate is dependable and half because the maximum falls on warm summer nights, with the radiant above the horizon all night long.
109P/斯威夫特—塔特尔彗星的核直径约 26 公里，是已知会周期性接近地球轨道: Comet 109P/Swift–Tuttle has a nucleus about 26 km across, making it one of the largest known objects that periodically approaches Earth’s orbit, on a cycle of roughly 133 years. It last returned in 1992, and Earth still crosses the dust it laid down along the way every August.
英仙座流星以约 59 公里每秒进入大气，其中不乏亮于金星的火流星，也常留下短暂的: Perseids enter the atmosphere at about 59 km/s, and a fair number outshine Venus and leave a brief train behind. The bright ones show even near a city, but counting the true rate still means getting away from the lights.
辐射点整夜可见，午夜后升高，出现率随之上升。: The radiant is up all night and climbs after midnight, taking the rate up with it.

辐射点位于猎户举起的“棍棒”附近，午夜后随猎户座升上高空。流星本身可能出现在天空: The radiant lies near the club Orion holds up, and climbs with the constellation after midnight. The meteors themselves can appear anywhere in the sky; staring at the radiant alone costs you the longest trails.
极大平缓，前后数夜的条件都接近峰值。: The peak is broad; several nights either side come close to it.
午夜后辐射点升高，黎明前最有利。: The radiant climbs after midnight, and the hours before dawn are best.
流星速度快，肉眼看到的多是一闪而过的细亮线。: The meteors are fast: to the eye most are a thin bright line, gone in an instant.
平时安静，却在母彗星回归前后可能爆发成流星暴。: Quiet in most years, yet capable of a storm around its parent comet’s return.
三十三年一遇的流星暴: A storm once in thirty-three years
狮子座流星雨在 11 月 17 日前后极大，常年每小时只有十余颗，但它是历史上最: The Leonids peak around 17 November at barely a dozen meteors an hour in a normal year, yet they produced the most spectacular storms on record: in 1833 and 1966 observers reported thousands, even tens of thousands, an hour. Those outbursts track the roughly 33-year return of the parent comet, 55P/Tempel–Tuttle.
彗星每次回归都会留下一条新的尘埃细丝。当地球恰好穿过一条年轻而致密的细丝时，出现: Every return lays down a fresh filament of dust. When Earth happens to cross a young, dense one, rates leap within an hour or two. The outbursts between 1999 and 2002 were predicted in advance — an important test that meteor astronomy passed.
太阳系里最快的流星: The fastest meteors in the solar system
狮子座流星以约 71 公里每秒迎面撞入大气，是主要流星雨中速度最快的。高速意味着: Leonids meet the atmosphere head-on at about 71 km/s, the highest speed among the major showers. That speed means brighter streaks, and trains that can linger for several seconds.
辐射点在午夜后升起，后半夜才进入状态。: The radiant rises after midnight; the shower only gets going in the small hours.
常年出现率不高，更适合当作长时间守候的项目。: Ordinary-year rates are low, so treat it as a long watch rather than a quick look.
爆发年份会有专门的预报，值得提前关注。: Outburst years come with dedicated forecasts worth following in advance.
一年中出现率最高的流星雨，母天体是一颗小行星。: The year’s richest shower, and the one whose parent is an asteroid.
一年之中最可靠的一场: The most dependable shower of the year
双子座流星雨在 12 月 14 日前后极大，理想条件下每小时超过 100 颗，是: The Geminids peak around 14 December at more than a hundred meteors an hour under ideal skies — the richest and steadiest shower of the year. The radiant is already up in the evening, so the whole night is usable, and at about 35 km/s the meteors are on the slow side, the brighter ones often yellow-white.
多数流星雨源自彗星，双子座却来自小行星 3200 法厄同。它的近日点只有 0.1: Most showers come from comets; this one comes from asteroid 3200 Phaethon. Its perihelion lies just 0.14 AU from the Sun, where heating cracks the surface and throws off dust — behaviour halfway between an asteroid and a comet. The stream is still thickening, and the Geminids have grown stronger over the past century.
适合初学者的一场: A good shower to start with
辐射点傍晚升起，出现率高、速度偏慢，即使在城市边缘也能看到一些较亮的成员。唯一的: The radiant rises in the evening, rates are high and the meteors are slow, so even the edge of a city shows the brighter ones. The only price is December cold: a reclining chair and enough warm clothing beat any instrument.
傍晚辐射点就已升起，不必等到后半夜。: The radiant is already up in the evening; there is no need to wait for the small hours.
流星偏慢、轨迹较长，适合固定机位的星野拍摄。: The meteors are slow with long trails, which suits fixed-camera nightscape shots.
躺下平视天顶附近，视野比追着辐射点更有效率。: Lie back and take in the sky near the zenith; that view catches more than chasing the radiant.
紧随双子座之后的小流星雨，辐射点终夜不落。: A modest shower right after the Geminids, with a radiant that never sets.
冬至前后的一场安静流星雨: A quiet shower around the solstice
小熊座流星雨在 12 月 22 日前后极大，常年每小时约 10 颗，容易被刚刚结: The Ursids peak around 22 December at roughly ten meteors an hour, and are easily overshadowed by the Geminids that have just ended. The radiant lies in Ursa Minor — circumpolar from northern mid and high latitudes, so it stays above the horizon all night.
1945 年和 1986 年曾出现每小时数十颗的增强，一般认为与母彗星 8P/塔: Rates of several dozen an hour were seen in 1945 and 1986, generally attributed to how the dust is distributed after parent comet 8P/Tuttle passes aphelion. Observations of this shower remain relatively scarce, so amateur counts still carry weight.
因为辐射点靠近北天极，北半球观测者不必等它升起，也不用担心它落下；代价是南半球几: Because the radiant sits near the north celestial pole, northern observers need not wait for it to rise or worry about it setting. The price is that the shower is all but invisible from the southern hemisphere.
辐射点终夜可见，任何时段都能开始观测。: The radiant is up all night, so you can start watching at any hour.
出现率低，建议连续观察一小时以上再做判断。: Rates are low; watch for at least an hour before judging the night.
南半球基本看不到，属于北半球专属的流星雨。: It is essentially invisible from the southern hemisphere: a northern shower only.
两个天体在天球上靠近到几乎相接，实际距离却仍然遥远。: Two bodies draw almost together on the sky while remaining vastly far apart.
看起来相邻，其实相隔数亿公里: Side by side to the eye, hundreds of millions of kilometres apart
当两个天体的黄经相同，就称为“合”。它们处在接近同一条视线的方向上，看上去可能相: Two bodies are in conjunction when they share the same ecliptic longitude. They lie along nearly the same line of sight and may appear less than a full Moon’s width apart, but that is only projection: in a conjunction of a planet with the Moon, the Moon is 380,000 km away and the planet usually hundreds of millions.
最常见的是行星合月：月球每个月都会从行星附近经过。行星之间的合少见得多，木星与土: The commonest is a planet with the Moon, which passes close to one every month. Conjunctions between planets are far rarer: the great conjunction of Jupiter and Saturn comes around every 20 years, and in 2020 the pair closed to about 0.1° — near enough to merge for the unaided eye. The inner planets add superior and inferior conjunctions, behind and in front of the Sun.
合相为什么值得看: Why a conjunction is worth watching
合相把亮度和颜色都不同的两个天体放进同一个视场，也是一堂直观的尺度课：同样明亮的: A conjunction puts two bodies of different brightness and colour in one field of view, and doubles as a lesson in scale: two equally bright points of light, one still inside the Earth–Moon system, the other far beyond the orbit of Jupiter.
行星合月、行星互合、内行星上合与下合: Planet with Moon, planet with planet, inferior and superior conjunction
合相前后几天都值得看，角距每天都在变化。: The days around a conjunction are worth watching too: the separation changes daily.
靠近太阳的合相只能在曙暮光中观察，注意避开太阳。: A conjunction close to the Sun can only be watched in twilight; keep clear of the Sun itself.
双筒或低倍望远镜常能把两者收进同一视场。: Binoculars or a low-power telescope will often hold both in one field.
外行星每一到两年一次: Once every one or two years for an outer planet
行星与太阳分列地球两侧，整夜可见，也最为明亮。: Planet and Sun stand on opposite sides of Earth: visible all night, and at its brightest.
一颗外行星一年中最好的夜晚: An outer planet’s best night of the year
当一颗外行星与太阳的黄经相差 180°，地球正好位于两者之间，这就是“冲”。此时: An outer planet is at opposition when its ecliptic longitude differs from the Sun’s by 180°, with Earth between the two. It then rises at sunset and sets at sunrise, stays up all night, and sits near its closest to Earth — so it looks brightest and shows its largest disc in a telescope.
冲日间隔取决于会合周期: The interval follows the synodic period
木星每约 13 个月冲日一次，火星约 26 个月一次。差别来自两颗行星与地球的角: Jupiter comes to opposition about every 13 months, Mars about every 26. The difference is the gap in angular speed between Earth and the planet: the further out the planet, the closer to one year Earth needs to lap it.
不是每次冲都一样近: Not every opposition is equally close
火星轨道的偏心率较大，“大冲”时距离约 0.37 AU，普通的冲则超过 0.6: Mars has a markedly eccentric orbit: at a perihelic opposition it comes within about 0.37 AU, at an ordinary one more than 0.6 AU, nearly doubling the apparent diameter. Saturn’s brightness at opposition also depends on the tilt of its rings, so no two oppositions of the same planet are alike.
太阳—地球—行星接近一条直线: Sun, Earth and planet nearly in line
午夜前后行星升到最高，大气宁静度也最好。: The planet rides highest around midnight, where the seeing is usually steadiest.
冲日前后数周的观测条件都接近最佳。: Conditions stay close to best for weeks either side of opposition.
水星和金星在地球轨道之内，不会出现冲。: Mercury and Venus orbit inside Earth’s, so they never come to opposition.
水星每年数次，金星约每 19 个月: Several times a year for Mercury, about every 19 months for Venus
内行星离太阳的视角距最大，也是最容易找到它们的时候。: An inner planet reaches its greatest angle from the Sun, and its easiest visibility.
水星和金星最容易被找到的日子: The days when Mercury and Venus are easiest to find
水星和金星的轨道在地球之内，从地球看，它们始终在太阳附近来回摆动。当这个角距达到: Mercury and Venus orbit inside Earth’s, so from here they only ever swing back and forth near the Sun. The extremes of that swing are the greatest elongations: at eastern elongation the planet stands low in the west after sunset, at western elongation low in the east before sunrise.
为什么水星这么难看到: Why Mercury is so hard to see
水星的最大角距只有 18° 到 28°，意味着它总在曙暮光中出没，高度低，受大气: Mercury’s greatest elongation is only 18° to 28°, which keeps it in twilight, low down and dimmed by the thick air near the horizon. Venus reaches about 47° and can hold a dark sky for hours, which is how it became the familiar morning and evening star.
内行星也有盈亏。大距前后，望远镜中的行星接近半圆形；越接近下合，它离地球越近、视: The inner planets show phases too. Near greatest elongation a telescope shows a half-lit disc; the closer the planet comes to inferior conjunction, the nearer and larger it grows while the lit part narrows, until only a thin hook is left.
日落后的西方低空: Low in the west after sunset
日出前的东方低空: Low in the east before sunrise
在日落后或日出前约 40 分钟寻找，地平线要开阔。: Look about 40 minutes after sunset or before sunrise, from a site with an open horizon.
金星亮度可达 −4 等，白天用望远镜也能找到。: Venus reaches magnitude −4 and can be picked up with a telescope in daylight.
太阳仍在地平线上时，绝不要用光学设备搜寻。: Never sweep with optics while the Sun is still above the horizon.
内行星从日面前方经过，罕见，而且必须用滤光设备观测。: An inner planet crosses the solar disc: rare, and only ever watched through a proper filter.
太阳表面上一个缓慢移动的黑点: A small dark dot creeping across the Sun
当水星或金星恰好从地球与太阳之间穿过，并且足够靠近黄道面时，我们会看到一个黑色小: When Mercury or Venus passes between Earth and the Sun close enough to the ecliptic plane, a small black disc creeps across the Sun: a transit. Orbital inclination makes the alignment rare — Mercury transits some 13 to 14 times a century, while Venus transits arrive in pairs eight years apart, separated by more than a century.
历史上的一把量天尺: A yardstick for the solar system
18 世纪的天文学家远赴各地观测金星凌日，用不同地点记录的接触时刻之差计算日地距: Eighteenth-century astronomers travelled the world to observe transits of Venus, deriving the Earth–Sun distance from the difference in contact times recorded at different sites. It was the first reasonably precise measurement of the astronomical unit, and an early model of international scientific cooperation.
今天的凌星观测: The same trick, applied to other stars
同样的几何关系被用在系外行星搜寻上：当行星从遥远恒星前方经过，恒星亮度会下降千分: The same geometry drives the search for exoplanets: when a planet crosses a distant star, the star dims by a fraction of a percent. Kepler and TESS found thousands of planets by watching for exactly that periodic, tiny dip.
行星处于下合，且靠近黄道面: Inferior conjunction, close to the ecliptic plane
必须使用合格的太阳滤光片，绝不可直视或用无防护的望远镜观看。: A certified solar filter is mandatory: never look directly, or through unfiltered optics.
投影法既安全，又适合多人一起观看。: Projection is safe and lets a group watch together.
水星的视面很小，需要望远镜，单靠日食眼镜看不到。: Mercury’s disc is tiny: a telescope is needed, and eclipse glasses alone will not show it.
较近的天体从更远的天体前方经过，把它短暂遮住。: A nearer body passes in front of a more distant one and briefly hides it.
一次精确到秒的遮挡: A blocking timed to the second
当一个较近的天体从更远天体的前方经过并将其遮住，就是掩星。最常见的是月掩星：月球: An occultation is a nearer body passing in front of a more distant one and blocking it.
